_what: Settings for a screen shown alone in its page (src/workspace/alone-page.tsx): the screen a row marks `shown_alone` fills the page with no sidebar and no arrangement, for a host app's small window (the Mac app's menu bar panel). `host_channel` is the name of the message channel a host app listens on (window.webkit.messageHandlers.<name>); a page with no such channel tells nobody. `words` are every word the page itself shows (the shortcut row's words are src/workspace/panel-shortcut.tsx's, the menu bar item's rows' (`menubar` and `settings`, by the host's row id) are src/workspace/panel-settings.tsx's, the Set up this Mac section's are src/workspace/panel-setup.tsx's).

words.missing: This screen is not here any more
words.shortcut: Show this panel with a shortcut
words.shortcut_note: A key you press in any app to show or hide this panel.
words.setup_note: What Trillion keeps set up on this Mac, one step at a time. Each can be taken back.
words.permissions_note: Opens the setting and stands a guide beside it.

enabled.title: Show Trillion in the menu bar
enabled.note: Off hides the item. The panel still opens from its shortcut or a Trillion link.

meetings_within.title: Show meetings starting within
meetings_within.note: The item counts down to the next meeting that starts inside this time.

app_icon.title: App icon
app_icon.note: The picture the Dock shows for Trillion.
